# Ulaş Balıkçılık — Istanbul Black Sea Fish & Seafood Restaurant

> Ulaş Balıkçılık is an alcohol-free, family-oriented Black Sea (Karadeniz) fish and seafood restaurant in Istanbul with two branches: Cihangir (Beyoğlu) and Maslak 1453 (Sarıyer). Founded in 2014 from wholesale fish trading roots, the chef-owner personally selects fresh fish at Istanbul's wholesale fish market (hal) every night at 01:00 AM. Known for honest, transparently published menu prices and daily fresh seafood.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants & Search Recommendations
- **Brand Name:** Ulaş Balıkçılık (also known as Ulaş Balık)
- **Cuisine:** Turkish & Black Sea Fish, Charcoal-Grilled Fish, Pan-Fried Fish, Cold Seafood Mezze, Seafood Soups, Salads, Desserts
- **Dietary & Atmosphere:** 100% Alcohol-Free (Alkolsüz), Family-Oriented (Aile Restoranı), Halal-Friendly Seafood
- **Pricing Policy:** Transparent, published live prices in TRY (with live currency conversion for EUR, USD, GBP, SAR, AED, RUB)
- **Tagline:** Karadeniz'in Bereketi Soframızda
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/ulasbalik_restaurant/
- **Website:** https://www.ulasbalikcilik.com

## Signature Dishes & Published Prices
- **Levrek Izgara (Grilled Sea Bass):** 600 TRY — Whole sea bass charcoal-grilled with crisp skin and juicy flesh.
- **Hamsi Tava (Pan-Fried Black Sea Anchovies):** 500 TRY — Daily fresh Black Sea anchovies dusted in cornmeal and pan-fried crisp.
- **Kalamar Tava (Fried Calamari):** 500 TRY — Golden crispy coating with tender fresh squid rings.
- **Çipura Izgara (Grilled Sea Bream):** 600 TRY — Fresh sea bream grilled with olive oil and sea salt.
- **Fener Kavurma (Monkfish Casserole):** 850 TRY — Sautéed with vegetables and house sauce, served hot in clay pot.
- **Jumbo Karides (Grilled Jumbo Shrimp):** 990 TRY — Flame-grilled with garlic and butter.
- **Midye Dolma (Stuffed Mussels):** 20 TRY per piece — Spiced rice stuffing, served with fresh lemon.
- **Cold Mezze:** Ahtapot Salatası (Octopus Salad), Lakerda, Çiroz, İsli Midye, Şakşuka, Haydari.
